x-k-k1-01.title: Sesiphi isikhombisi esikhokelela kwindawo yokupaka?
x-k-k1-01.goal: Funda izikhombisi ezintathu zendlela ezimfutshane, udibanise amagama notolo nophawu oluchaziweyo, uze ugwebe ukuba sesiphi ngokwenene esikhokelela undwendwe ukuba lipake; khusela ugwebo ngokuchasene nokufunda kwesiqingatha komhlobo.
x-k-k1-01.material:
Undwendwe luqhuba lufika esikolweni kwaye lufuna ukushiya imoto iyure e-1. Izikhombisi ezintathu ziyabonakala (akukho mifanekiso, ngoko zichazwa ngamagama).

Isikhombisi A: oonobumba abamhlophe '주차 금지' kwibhodi ebomvu. Isangqa esibomvu esinomgca othe tye siwela umzobo omncinci wemoto. Sibotshelelwe kucingo lwesikolo.
Isikhombisi B: ibhodi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oonobumba abamhlophe '방문자 주차장' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasekunene. Simi ecaleni kwendlela.
Isikhombisi C: ibhodi eluhlaza, oonobumba abamhlophe '주차장 출구' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasemva ngakwindlela. Sixhonywe phezu kwendlela emxinwa apho iimoto zihamba zingaphandle.

Amagama: 주차(장) = indawo yokupaka; 방문자 = undwendwe; 입구 = ukungena; 출구 = ukuphuma.
x-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Uyazi ukuba umcibisholo kwisikhombisi ubonisa indlela yokuhamba
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi isikhombisi ekufuneka undwendwe lisilandele ukuze lipake?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dwelisa oko isikhombisi ngasinye sikuthethayo ngamagama, nokuba uphawu lwaso okanye umcibisholo wongeza ntoni.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ngesikhombisi ngasinye: ingaba sithumela imoto ngaphakathi, ngaphandle, okanye hayi ndawo?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: 주차장 isesi sikhombisi, kodwa lilinye kuphela legama ezimbini. Khangela oko igama lesibini nomcibisholo bakuthethayo ngendlela iimoto ezihamba ngayo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Esi sikhombisi sinayo i-주차 nasi. Jonga isangqa esibomvu esinomgca: yintoni uphawu olunjalo lwakuxelela ngokuqhelekileyo?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Udibanise igama lundwendwe, igama lokupaka nomcibisholo. Yiyo leyo indlela esifundwa ngayo isikhombisi njengesipheleleyo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Isikhombisi B okanye Isikhombisi C; zombini zithi 주차장 kwaye zinomcibisholo
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: Zombini zithi 주차장 kwaye zinomcibisholo, kodwa jonga oko elinye igama le-Isikhombisi C nesalathiso somcibisholo waso zikuthethayo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Isikhombisi B sesabundwendwe, sibiza indawo yokupaka kwaye sinika isalathiso. Isikhombisi A sinegama lokuqala elifanayo kodwa sithwele uphawu lwenqanaba. Isikhombisi C sibiza indawo yokupaka nasi, kodwa 출구 ithetha ukuphuma, ngoko sibonisa apho iimoto zishiya khona.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo uthi: 'Isikhombisi C sinayo i-주차장, ngoko masingene ngapho.' Phendula umhlobo wakho ngezivakalisi ezimbini zesiNgesi okanye ezimbalwa, usebenzisa oko isikhombisi sikuthethayo ngokwenene.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Lelipi igama le-Isikhombisi C elahlukileyo kweli le-Isikhombisi B?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Iimoto ziya phi kwindlela enesikhombisi sokuphuma?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ndisebenzise igama lesikhombisi njengobungqina, hayi nje uluvo lwam?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndithe sisetyenziselwa ntoni isikhombisi (ukuphuma) nokuba sifuna ntoni endaweni yaso?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba umhlobo wam wayeya kwazi ukuba ajonge phi emva koko?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Isikhombisi C sithi 출구, nto leyo ethetha ukuphuma. Iimoto zihamba zikho ngaphandle apho, ngoko kufuneka sikhangele indawo yokungena, njengomcibisholo kwi-Isikhombisi B.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.0: Ibiza igama eliphambili nendawo yokungena engekhoyo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 주차장 yisiqingatha kuphela. Elinye igama, 출구, likuxelela ukuba iimoto ziyaphuma apho, ngoko besiza kuqhuba ngendlela engalunganga.

오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Amagama: 오전 = a.m.; 오후 = p.m.; 낮 = emini; 쉬어요 = (liphumla); ~ ifundwa 'ukuya' (ukusuka ... ukuya ...). Ufuna ukutyelela ngoLwesithathu.

x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala isivakalisi esinye okanye ezimbini zesiNgesi kumhlobo othi 'livulekile ukususela ku-9 ukuya ku-6, naliphi na ixesha lilungile': ngawaphi amaxesha ahluleka, kwaye kutheni?

x-k-k1-02.title: Ukuba iyana, ngaba i-picnic iyaqhubeka?
x-k-k1-02.goal: Thelekisa inqaku elithathwe ngesiNgesi nesaziso soqobo sesiKorean, ufumane umgca othi ngaphezu kwesaziso, uze ubhale umthetho wesiKorean ngokwakho.
x-k-k1-02.material:
Utitshala unamathelise isaziso emnyango weklasi:

내일은 소풍 가요.
9시까지 학교에 오세요.
도시락을 가져오세요.
비가 오면 소풍을 안 가요.

Amagama: 소풍 = uhambo/i-picnic; 도시락 = ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini; 비 = imvula; 오다 = ukuza (비가 오다 = iyana imvula); 안 = hayi.

UJoon wasifunda wabhala amanqaku mane esiNgesi (aboniswe ngezantsi).

Amagama angakumbi (kwinyathelo 2): 눈 = ikhephu (눈이 오다 = liyana ikhephu); 공원 = ipaki.

Amagama: 사과 = iapile; 배 = ipere; 다 = zonke; 팔았어요 = zithengisiwe; 내일 오세요 = nceda uze ngomso.

x-k-k1-08.title: Ziphi 'izihlangu zisuswe' ziya khona?
x-k-k1-08.goal: Hambelanisa uphawu olunye nendawo apho lunokuxhonywa khona, usebenzisa iinkcukacha zomboniso ngamnye, uze uqaphele into uphawu olungayithethi.
x-k-k1-08.material:
Uphawu luthi: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요.

Amagama: 신발 = izihlangu; 벗다 = ukukhulula; 들어오세요 = nceda ungene.

Iindawo ezintathu, ezichazwe ngamagama:
Indawo 1: ivenkile yezihlangu. Abathengi bazama izihlangu baze behambe kwikapethi ebhityileyo.
Indawo 2: indawo encinci yokutyela. Indawo yokutya yindawo ephakamileyo yomthi enetafile eziphantsi. Emnyango kukho umqolo wezihlangu kwisinyathelo selitye.
Indawo 3: i-gym yesikolo. Umgangatho womthi wacocwa izolo. Abafundi banxiba izihlangu ezicocekileyo zangaphakathi apho.
